summary: The control people press to do one thing now: run an action, submit or reset its form, or, with href, open a link styled as a button.

variant.note: Emphasis level. One primary per view.

size.note: 24/32/36/40px high (tiny/small/medium/large); icon sizes are square and need aria-label.

type.note: Form behavior. Defaults to button so it never submits by accident.

disabled.note: Native disabled: dimmed, not interactive, out of the tab order. With href, the link loses its href. Wins over loading.

loading.note: Harness addition: spinner before the label, dimmed; stays focusable with aria-busy and aria-disabled.

name.note: Submitted with the form when type is submit.

value.note: Submitted with name when type is submit.

label.note: Default slot: visible text and accessible name.

href.note: Renders a native link styled as a button. type, name and value are ignored; disabled removes the href. javascript:, vbscript: and data: URLs are dropped: the link renders without href and a console warning names it (SB-0115).

anatomy.name: button
anatomy.notes: Native <button> in the shadow root; receives focus and keyboard input.

anatomy.name: spinner
anatomy.notes: sb-spinner, decorative; takes the leading-icon position while loading.

default.notes: Short verb phrase in sentence case. With icon sizes, the default slot holds the icon and aria-label names it.

leading-icon.notes: Decorative; Button sets aria-hidden. Uses the icon-size token; padding switches to padding-x-icon.

click.note: Pointer, Enter or Space. Cancelled while disabled or loading.

hover.note: primary, destructive and secondary darken by mixing their background (90%, 90%, 80%).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring so it reaches 3:1 (the visual reference uses a translucent ring; see drift).

loading.note: Looks disabled with a spinner; remains focusable.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: Default slot text. Host aria-label is forwarded to the inner control. aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are not forwarded: ID references do not resolve across shadow roots (SB-0009).

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: submit calls form.requestSubmit(), reset calls form.reset(); name and value are submitted.

accessibility.targetSize: At least 24x24px in every size (WCAG 2.5.8); the smallest (tiny, icon-tiny) is 24px.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once per element, when there is no text and no aria-label (always relevant for icon sizes).

keyboard.Tab: move focus in and out, also while loading

aria: loading: aria-busy="true" and aria-disabled="true"; stays focusable (fix over native disabled)
disabled: native disabled; as a link, role="link" without href and aria-disabled="true"
disabled wins over loading: no spinner, not busy
host.click() activates the inner control and is ignored while disabled or loading

openQuestions.question: Icon-only buttons: label prop on Button, or a separate component?
openQuestions.answer: size=icon | icon-tiny | icon-small | icon-large on Button, named with aria-label (forwarded). No separate Icon Button.

openQuestions.question: Loading: keep the label with a spinner, or replace it?
openQuestions.answer: Spinner before the visible label, dimmed, with the a11y fixes: stays focusable, aria-busy, aria-disabled.

openQuestions.question: Sizes?
openQuestions.answer: Sizes: medium, tiny, small, large, icon, icon-tiny, icon-small, icon-large (SB-0006).

openQuestions.question: Should Button render a link when it navigates? Add an href prop that renders a native <a> with button styling?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes: href renders <a part="button">, keeps link semantics, ignores type/name/value.
openQuestions.answer: Yes (SB-0006): href renders <a part="button">; links keep link semantics.
